# WHYY

> WHYY is a leading public media organization serving Pennsylvania, Delaware, and New Jersey with radio, television, podcasts, and educational programming.

WHYY operates WHYY-FM radio and WHYY-TV, providing regional news coverage, NPR content, PBS programming, and community-focused educational initiatives across the Philadelphia region and surrounding areas.

## Key Topics

- WHYY-FM
- WHYY-TV

## Education & Youth Programs

- [Education - WHYY](https://whyy.org/education): Education programs and youth media initiatives in PA, NJ, DE
- [WHYY Youth Media - WHYY](https://whyy.org/education/whyy-youth-media): Youth media training and production programs in Philadelphia
- [WHYY Media Labs Program - WHYY](https://whyy.org/education/whyy-media-labs-program): Media Labs school partnership program with hands-on learning
- [WHYY Pathways to Media Careers - WHYY](https://whyy.org/pathways-to-media-careers-youth-employment-project): Youth internship and journalism training program in Philadelphia
- [For Students - WHYY](https://whyy.org/education/for-students): After-school media production training for high school students
- [WHYY Early Education Programs - WHYY](https://whyy.org/whyy-early-education-programs): Early education literacy and math programs for families
